graph.title: IKEA BEKVÄM step stool — assembly

steps.title: Attach the lower step to one side frame
steps.instruction: Align the lower tread with the side-frame pockets and drive the screws until snug.

steps.title: Fit the upper step
steps.instruction: Seat the upper tread and fasten it to the same side frame.

steps.title: Close the stool with the second side
steps.instruction: Offer up the second side frame, start every screw, then tighten evenly.

steps.title: Add the braces and check stability
steps.instruction: Install the cross braces. Stand on a level floor and confirm there is no wobble before use.
warnings: Do not stand on the stool until every screw is tight.

notes: From the IKEA 3D Assembly Dataset (Inter IKEA Systems B.V.).

evaluation.critique: The image is high quality and generally shows a wooden assembly with a screw being driven, which partially matches the intended step. However, it appears to show more than one side frame already attached and includes a BRACE prominently assembled, while the planned scene is specifically attaching the lower step to one side frame. That makes the sequence look too advanced. The labeled BRACE is an allowed BOM item but is not part of this scene intent, so it functions as an invented/extra visible assembly focus for this step. The callout requirement is also off: SCREW should be the emphasized callout, but multiple labels are shown and the scene focus is diluted. To improve: show only one SIDE frame, the STEP being aligned into its pockets, visible SCREW insertion, and avoid showing the second side/brace already assembled.

However, part labeling is incomplete and slightly ambiguous: SIDE and SCREW are clearly indicated, but BRACE is not called out and STEP is labeled on the lower frame area rather than clearly identifying the step board component.
